newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends lower, July holds support.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends lower, July holds support.

text.p: CSCE July world sugar futures ended weaker but up from session lows and above support, which had been pierced in early trade.
Floor sources said trade buying lifted most-active July over 11.00 cents a lb after the contract sank to a low of 10.95 cents amid fund selling.
The selling failed to pressure the contract to firmer support at Friday's low of 10.91, however, under which sell stops are seen lurking.
The next level of support was pegged at 10.77 cents, a low set April 17.
Market sources expect trade to remain rangebound ahead of May delivery's expiry Wednesday. Open interest in May stood at 21,223 lots, down 3,551 lots, as of early Monday.

July gained 1,066 lots to stand at 86,835 lots. It closed down 0.04 cent at 11.03 cents after trading from 11.05 to 10.95 cents. Spot May eased 0.17 to 11.32, while the outer months ended unchanged to 0.04 lower.
The May/July spread tightened to 0.29 cent from 0.42 cent at Monday's close.
Volume was estimated at 25,619 lots, compared with Monday's official 21,592 lots.
Resistance for July remained at 11.18-11.20 cents, where producer selling is expected to emerge.
((-- S Rostler, New York Commodities Desk, 212 859 1640))
